title: Strings
summary: Immutable text: indexing, slicing, the most useful str methods, split and join.
hints: `reverse_words`: `text.split()` with no argument splits on any run of whitespace and drops empty pieces. Reverse the list with `[::-1]` or `reversed(...)`, then `" ".join(...)` puts it back together.

`is_palindrome`: build a cleaned string first: `"".join(ch.lower() for ch in text if ch.isalnum())`. Then compare it with its reverse, `cleaned[::-1]`. `initials`: `word[0].upper()` for each word of `name.split()`, each followed by a dot.

`mask_email`: `local, _, domain = email.partition("@")` splits at the first `@`. The masked local part is `local[0] + "***"`. `slug`: lower-case, turn every character that is not alphanumeric into a space (`ch if ch.isalnum() else " "`), then `"-".join(cleaned.split())`.
